name: project-card
title: Project card
description: A project at a glance: name, status, a progress line, team avatars and due date, as one clickable card with a menu.
docs: project is { id, name, description, status, progress, members, due, completedAt, icon, href }; status is planning, active, on-hold, completed or archived and is written in words with its own mark. The card is one stretched link (project.href) or button (onOpen) with a ring around all of it on focus; the star toggle (starred and onStar) and the overflow menu (menu, a list of { id, label, icon, destructive, onSelect }) are separate controls above it, so pressing them never opens the project. An archived project is dimmed by its surface and its tile rather than by opacity, so it stays readable. The tile shows icon, or the first letter of the name. ProjectCardSkeleton is the same card as a placeholder. It sizes to its column, so it works in any responsive grid. The due date comes from DueDateLabel; a completed project shows Done on 12 Oct from completedAt instead, and an archived one shows no date, so a finished project never reads as overdue. Pass now for deterministic words in tests and previews.
